description: Provenance figure: Knh4 domain architecture, Ig-like fold assignment, absence of CBM/GH structural neighbours, conservation vs solvent exposure, and catalytic acid/base pair test
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json, re, collections
M=pd.read_csv('knh4_domain_conservation_sasa.csv')
res=json.load(open('foldseek_domain_result.json'))
store={}
for db in res['results']:
    flat=[]
    for a in db['alignments']: flat.extend(a if isinstance(a,list) else [a])
    store[db['db']]=flat
sf=collections.Counter()
for a in store['cath50']:
    m=re.search(r'_(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)$', a['target'].split()[0])
    if m: sf[m.group(1)]+=1
pairs=pd.read_csv('knh4_acidic_pair_distances.csv')

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16.5,9.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3, hspace=0.42, wspace=0.28)

# A: domain architecture
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
segs=[(1,16,'signal\npeptide','#8d99ae'),(17,115,'Kre9/Knh1 Ig-like\ndomain (PF10342)','#2b5d8a'),
      (116,299,'Ser/Thr-rich O-glycosylated\nlow-complexity stalk (68% S+T)','#d98c34'),
      (300,317,'GPI signal','#a63d40')]
for s,e,lab,c in segs:
    ax.barh(0,e-s+1,left=s,height=0.45,color=c,edgecolor='k')
    ax.text((s+e)/2, 0.38, lab, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5)
ax.plot([111,114],[-0.33,-0.33],'k-',lw=1.5); ax.text(112,-0.47,'C111-C114\nS-S 2.02 A',ha='center',fontsize=7)
ax.plot([42],[-0.3],'v',color='#2a9d8f'); ax.text(42,-0.47,'N42\nN-glyc',ha='center',fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlim(0,325); ax.set_ylim(-0.75,0.85); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel('Residue'); ax.set_title('A  Knh4 (O42970, 317 aa) architecture', loc='left', fontweight='bold')

# B: fold census
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
lbl=['2.60.40.10\nIg-like beta-sandwich','2.60.40.150\nC2 domain-like','2.60.40.3330',
     '2.60.120.290\nGalactose-binding','all other (161 SFs)']
val=[sf['2.60.40.10'],sf['2.60.40.150'],sf['2.60.40.3330'],sf['2.60.120.290'],
     sum(sf.values())-sf['2.60.40.10']-sf['2.60.40.150']-sf['2.60.40.3330']-sf['2.60.120.290']]
ax.barh(lbl[::-1], val[::-1], color=['#c9ced6','#c9ced6','#c9ced6','#c9ced6','#2b5d8a'][::-1])
for i,v in enumerate(val[::-1]): ax.text(v+8,i,str(v),va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('Foldseek hits (CATH50, domain-only query, n=870)')
ax.set_title('B  Fold of the Knh4 domain: immunoglobulin-like', loc='left', fontweight='bold')

# C: CAZy absence
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
cats=['Ig / antibody / TCR /\nreceptor domains','glycoside hydrolase\n(catalytic)','carbohydrate-binding\nmodule (CBM)','transglycosylase /\nglucanosyltransferase','glycosyltransferase']
n=[439,2,0,0,0]
ax.barh(cats[::-1], n[::-1], color=['#2b5d8a']+['#a63d40']*4)
for i,v in enumerate(n[::-1]): ax.text(v+6,i,str(v),va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('Matching hits among 841 PDB100 Foldseek hits')
ax.set_title('C  No CBM or catalytic CAZyme among structural neighbours', loc='left', fontweight='bold')

# D: conservation track
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ax.bar(M.resnum, M.frac_identical, color=np.where(M.rsa<0.10,'#2b5d8a','#d98c34'), width=0.95)
for n_ in [40,78,90,106,102,76]:
    r=M[M.resnum==n_].iloc[0]
    ax.annotate(f"{r.aa}{n_}", (n_, r.frac_identical), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xlabel('Residue number'); ax.set_ylabel('Fraction identical (471 fungal homologs)')
ax.set_title('D  Conservation: buried (blue) exceeds exposed (orange)', loc='left', fontweight='bold')

# E: conservation vs exposure
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
isar=M.aa.isin(list('WYF'))
ax.scatter(M.loc[~isar,'rsa'], M.loc[~isar,'frac_identical'], c='#9aa5b1', s=30, edgecolor='k', lw=.3, label='other residues')
ax.scatter(M.loc[isar,'rsa'], M.loc[isar,'frac_identical'], c='#a63d40', s=52, edgecolor='k', lw=.4, label='Trp/Tyr/Phe')
for n_ in [40,78,90,106,102,76,105,83]:
    r=M[M.resnum==n_].iloc[0]
    ax.annotate(f"{r.aa}{n_}", (r.rsa, r.frac_identical), fontsize=7.5, xytext=(4,3), textcoords='offset points')
ax.axvline(0.25, ls='--', c='grey', lw=1); ax.text(0.26,0.03,'exposed ->',fontsize=7,color='grey')
ax.set_xlabel('Relative solvent accessibility'); ax.set_ylabel('Fraction identical')
ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='upper right')
ax.set_title('E  The 4 invariant aromatics are buried core, not a\n     surface binding platform (buried vs exposed p=4.7e-3)', loc='left', fontweight='bold')

# F: acidic pair geometry
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2])
cons=dict(zip(M.resnum, M.frac_identical))
lab=[f"{a}-{b}" for a,b in zip(pairs.res1,pairs.res2)]
ax.barh(lab[::-1], pairs.dist_A.values[::-1], color='#8d99ae')
ax.axvspan(4.5,6.5, color='#2a9d8f', alpha=0.25)
ax.axvspan(9.0,10.5, color='#e9c46a', alpha=0.35)
ax.text(5.5,4.55,'retaining GH',ha='center',fontsize=7,color='#1d6f66')
ax.text(9.7,4.55,'inverting GH',ha='center',fontsize=7,color='#8a6d1d')
for i,(r1,r2) in enumerate(zip(pairs.res1[::-1],pairs.res2[::-1])):
    c=min(cons.get(int(re.sub(r'\D','',r1)),0), cons.get(int(re.sub(r'\D','',r2)),0))
    ax.text(pairs.dist_A.values[::-1][i]+0.15, i, f"min cons {c:.2f}", va='center', fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlim(0,13.5); ax.set_xlabel('Carboxylate-carboxylate distance (A)')
ax.set_title('F  No conserved catalytic acid/base pair\n     (all 10 Asp/Glu are <50% conserved)', loc='left', fontweight='bold')
plt.show()
